provenance.standard: Project-defined wireframe notation; WCAG 2.2 is an accessibility reference, not a wireframe notation

rules.description: Declare viewport units, fidelity, design-system version, component states, interaction legend, and repeated-component groups before approval.
A diagram can flag contrast, label, and target-size risks but cannot prove implemented WCAG conformance.
Preserve containment, alignment, spacing, z-order, and declared dimensions for every repeated-component group.
Map every interaction edge to a declared interaction-legend entry.
The live Bootstrap-style button proves renderer availability only; confirm component semantics, state, and design-system version separately.
